proposals.title: Shareholder Proposal Regarding a Change in the Treatment of Abstentions for Purposes of Vote Counting
proposals.proponent: Newground Social Investment, SPC, on behalf of the Equality Network Foundation; Boston Common Asset Management, on behalf of the Boston Common U.S. Equity Fund
proposals.topic_summary: Asks the Board to amend governing documents so non-binding shareholder matters are decided by a simple majority of votes cast FOR and AGAINST, excluding abstentions.
proposals.evidence: Our Board unanimously recommends that you vote "AGAINST" this proposal.

proposals.title: Shareholder Proposal Regarding a Policy to Prohibit Vesting of Deferred Equity Awards for Senior Executives Who Resign to Enter Government Service
proposals.proponent: The Reserve Fund of the American Federation of Labor and Congress of Industrial Organizations
proposals.topic_summary: Requests a policy prohibiting vesting of equity awards for senior executives who voluntarily resign to enter government service (Government Service Golden Parachute).
proposals.evidence: Our Board unanimously recommends that you vote "AGAINST" this proposal.
